issue_date 2026-09-01 is in the future. Pre-billing is the single most common eligibility breach.

Stated terms are 30 days but issue-to-due is 60 days.
DE is a decentralised regime: the Peppol/EN 16931 payload proves transport, not state attestation. Do not treat structured as verified.
